caseNameFull: N. A. Callison v. William J. Brake, Administrator, etc.

opinions.text: May 31, 1904. Petition for a writ of certiorari to the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit denied. Mr. C. D. Rinehart and Mr. E. P. Axtell for petitioner. Mr. H. Bisbee and Mr. George C. Bedell for respondent.
